help.overview.title: Overview
help.overview.1: At the top you see what is open and overdue and what arrived this month.
help.overview.2: “Due” lists invoices that are overdue or due in the next 7 days. “Paid” records the open amount with today's date.
help.overview.3: The eye at the top hides all amounts, e.g. when someone is looking over your shoulder.
help.invoices.title: Invoices
help.invoices.1: A draft can be changed as often as you like. When issued, the invoice gets its sequential number and the PDF is stored on MiniNode.
help.invoices.2: Issued invoices are cancelled, not deleted: a cancellation invoice with its own number reverses them. That keeps the numbering without gaps.
help.invoices.3: On a computer, select several invoices with the boxes (Shift for a range) and mark them paid together. The calendar shows due dates.
help.items.title: Building blocks
help.items.1: Building blocks are your recurring services and products with net price, unit and VAT rate.
help.items.2: In an invoice you insert them under “Items”; you can still change quantity and price there.
help.items.3: Bring over a list from your previous program with the CSV import in Settings.
help.stats.title: Statistics
help.stats.1: “Net invoiced” is the sum of your issued invoices without VAT, minus cancellations: an estimate of your turnover.
help.stats.2: “Gross received” is what actually reached your account, by payment date.
help.stats.3: The year export below holds everything for the tax return: PDFs, sales ledger, payments received and totals per VAT rate.
hint.invoicesLocked: You can change drafts at any time. Issued invoices are cancelled, not deleted.
hint.itemsReuse: You add building blocks to an invoice with one tap.
hint.statsMeaning: Net is estimated (invoiced), gross is actual (received).
